movie.title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
movie.overview: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a stubborn bride refuses to move into her new home, her newlywed husband must navigate the comedic and emotional challenges of living under his in-laws' roof.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam follows a newly married couple facing an unexpected hurdle immediately after their wedding. The bride makes the unorthodox decision to stay in her ancestral family home rather than moving in with her husband's family. Determined to make the marriage work, her husband agrees to move into his in-laws' household. He must quickly adapt to their unique dynamic, balancing his own self-respect with his love for his wife.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam opens with the grand wedding of a young couple, but the celebration quickly shifts into an unconventional arrangement. Right after the rituals conclude, the bride firmly refuses to leave her childhood home and family, upending traditional post-wedding expectations. Driven by his love for her and a desire to keep the marriage intact, the husband makes the difficult choice to pack his bags and move in under his in-laws' roof. Once settled, he finds himself navigating the complex, often overwhelming dynamics of a family that is set in its ways. Every day brings a new test of patience as he struggles to fit into an unfamiliar domestic routine while striving to earn the respect of his in-laws. Meanwhile, the bride's deep attachments to her family create friction, forcing the couple to re-evaluate their communication and expectations. Comedic misunderstandings and emotional confrontations arise as the husband balances his own dignity against his devotion to his wife. As tensions peak, both families are forced to confront their rigid views on tradition and compromise. Ultimately, the couple must determine whether love alone is strong enough to redefine marital boundaries and unite two distinct lives.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam is a charming blend of romance, comedy, and family drama that explores modern marital dynamics through an unexpected lens. The story centers on a young groom whose post-wedding life takes a sudden detour when his bride refuses to relocate to his family home. Choosing love over convention, the husband agrees to move into his in-laws' house, setting off a wave of cultural clashes, hilarious household friction, and heartfelt moments of self-discovery. As he attempts to adapt to the household's idiosyncratic rules and earn his place within the family, the film offers an engaging, spoiler-free look at the compromises, patience, and humor required to build a lasting bond.

story_structure.resolution: The couple and family reach a deeper understanding, finding a balanced way forward that respects both family ties and marital independence.
